ShortDescription.Value: Responding emergency vehicles stop despawning in traffic jams and re-route around congestion.

Publish.LongDescription:
Vanilla Cities Skylines II deletes a responding fire engine, ambulance or police car outright once it is flagged as stuck in traffic, and never re-evaluates its route after dispatch. This mod keeps responding units alive and re-routes them around congestion using the game's own pathfinding.
Source (open source, MIT): https://github.com/AmicusDeus/EmergencyPriority
Localized into 11 languages (German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese-BR, Russian, Chinese Simplified & Traditional). Translations are machine-generated — corrections welcome.
Made with Claude Code's Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 models.

ChangeLog.Value: v1.04 — Localization: the Options page and in-game panels are now translated into 11 languages (German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese-BR, Russian, Chinese Simplified & Traditional). Machine-translated — community corrections welcome.
